title: A both-direction relationship on the bridge table carries a Customer filter to the accounts' transactions

source.supports: the page gives these rows and states the two balances once the Account / AccountCustomer relationship filters both ways: 75 and 275

source.quote: The logical many-to-many relationship between Customer and Account is implemented through two physical SMR relationships
source.supports: the bridge pattern with a bidirectional filter

derivation: Customer-91 -> AccountCustomer row (1, 91) -> Account 1 (both directions) -> Transactions 100 and -25 = 75. Customer-92 -> rows (1, 92), (2, 92) -> Accounts 1 and 2 -> 100 + 200 - 25 = 275.
notes: The model's Transactions table is the page's Transaction table; Amount is a whole number column, so the sum is int64.
